title: Don’t hesitate, book it now with Jordi! You wont regret it!
text: We cannot recommend Jordi enough the Sagrada Família tour! Experiencing Gaudí’s masterpiece with him made all the difference. Not only is he incredibly knowledgeable—bringing the history, architecture, and intricate symbolism of the basilica to life in a way we never would have appreciated on our own—but his friendly and engaging personality kept us completely captivated from start to finish. Jordi truly went above and beyond to make sure we had the best possible experience, navigating the crowds smoothly, answering every question, and even sharing recommendations for the rest of our time in S
author: annadB5508SX

title: Breathtaking!!
text: We had a great and informative tour of the incredible Sagrada Basilica. We were a little late due to a 24 hour strike but the guide was able to accomodate us on the next tour which was extremely kind. After the tour we were able to linger as long as we wanted inside, and out.  Despite the crowds it did not feel crazy.  Photos really do not do it justice - just go and experience!
author: Vacationer769131
